body:
I was visiting a friend of mine that had moved when we were younger.  Back when he lived here we were kinde of pot heads, just like child hood fun.  Well when i went to viset him i had found out that he had not changed much.  He still likes to smoke every day, ther is nothing wrong with that but i have found that as i gow up i have grown away from pot smoking.  The first day i got there we took some bong rips and it was pleasant at first, but it soon made me feal dirty and tired.  I dont like to be high any more.  I have however grown quite fond of drinking.  When we culd not get a hold of any drink, and i did not want to smoke i told him that i have herd that drinking Robotussin culd make you drunk.  So we each bought 2 four oz bottles and chugged them, it was probly around 10:00.  About 11:00 i felt light headed like when you smoke a cigaret for the first time, but not as intense.  We decided to Put on Wu-Chronicles chapter 2 to listen to.  By the third or fourth song(Got's like come on through) i felt odd, fanitly diffrent somewher but not were i was i was weird.  Somthing was creeping up my spine like the first rising wave of an acid trip.  And the words to some dumb hip hop song were inspiring, but why.  I kept thinking come on through?  To where? It gave me many ideas for paintings, but i was really confused.  Did those words have meaning, i culd not here the rest of the song, just the chours.  I was itrested inspired yet scared at the same time.  Then i snapped out of it.  I realized holy shit this is not like being drink at all.  I looked at the clock it was a quarter to one.  How long had i been playing that song, what had my friend been doing.  I got up and bamn i felt like was hit by a car.  My chest was sore and i culd not focus.  A few miniutes later i was sitting down again and then i looked around the room.  Terrable things were happining all around us, but i was not scared. Why? i fealt like i was above it all, observing.  The shadows they were laughing, or were they crying i culd not tell.  My friend, he was staring at the black light on his cealing, i asked if he wanted to go and have a smoke he agreed.  I decided i better not tell him about the shadows, with any luck he would not see them.  I dont think he did because he was rambilig about how the 'moon was inside tonight' i dont know what he ment, just crazy talk.  I went a got a cigeret from my guest room, and met him in the hall.  We went down the stairs, wich proved a great task.  No bodily coordination, my head felt clear but my body had no control.  We went out side and smoked, this just made the whole thing more intense.  We stayed out there just sitting and looking out over the lake thats just down the hill from his yard, till it started getting light. Once the real intense starts begining to wear off it is quite a plesant and euporic state of being. I will alwase remember watching that lake, we shared a millon things and never said a word, just listend to the earth outside that was the best part of the trip.  Then we got up and went to bed.  Roughly 4:00 am i awoke around 11:00 am and felt fine refreshed and plesant the DXM had all worn off but i fealt humbled by the whole experiance.  No hangover just really really dry eyes, but no big deal.  If you ever have a friend that you will have to part with soon, Trip on dxm just the 2 of you one night and sit peace fully out side.  You dont evan have to talk.  Just listen.
